steps.text: Face the screen and hold still
Turn slowly left and right, a few times
Nod slowly up and down, a few times
Tilt your head slowly to each shoulder
Face the screen and hold still
Turn about 30 degrees left and hold
Turn about 30 degrees right and hold
Hold still, then snap your head quickly to the left and back. Repeat
Face the screen and hold still
Quick head shakes, left and right
Face the screen and hold still
Turn as far left as is comfortable, then as far right
Face the screen and hold still
